subcategory_text: Integrity checking mechanisms are used to verify software, firmware, and information integrity.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-7 (Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity), SI-7(1) (Integrity Checks)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.28 (Secure coding), A.8.29 (Security testing)
implementation_examples: Use integrity-checking mechanisms (digital signatures, hashes, attested boot) to verify software, firmware, and information integrity
Document the integrity policies and validation cadence
React to integrity failures as security incidents
assessment_objectives: Determine whether integrity-checking mechanisms are used for software, firmware, and information
Determine whether the mechanisms are documented and tested
Determine whether integrity failures are handled as security incidents
Determine whether integrity checks cover third-party components
